It is the second volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]'', following ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'' ([[1991]]) and preceding ''[[The Last Command]]'' ([[1993]]). It was first published in hardcover by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[May]] [[1992]], and it was later adapted into a [[Star Wars: Dark Force Rising (comic series)|''Star Wars: Dark Force Rising'' comic adaptation]].
